stories.headline: US 10-year yield hits highest since 2007 as markets price 70% odds of October Fed hike

key_facts.fact: On Monday Sept 28 the 10-year Treasury yield briefly topped 5.27% before settling at 5.23%, back to 2007 levels; the 30-year rose to 5.55%, a level last seen in 2004.
key_facts.excerpt: the yield on the 10-year Treasury briefly topped 5.27% before pulling back to 5.23%, up from 5.17% late Friday. It's back to where it was in 2007... The 30-year Treasury yield rose to 5.55% from 5.49% and is back to where it was in 2004.

key_facts.fact: The S&P 500 fell 0.8% to 7,683.69, the Dow dropped 347 points (0.7%) to 51,481.51 and the Nasdaq fell 0.9% to 26,820.38.
key_facts.excerpt: the S&P 500 fell 59.72 points to 7,683.69. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 347.11 to 51,481.51, and the Nasdaq composite sank 248.34 to 26,820.38.

key_facts.fact: CME FedWatch put the chance of at least a 25bp Fed hike at the October meeting at 70.3%, up from 57.6% a week earlier and 17.7% a month earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: Markets are currently pricing in a 70.3% chance for an increase of at least 25 basis points at the central bank's meeting next month, up from 57.6% a week ago and 17.7% a month earlier, according to CME FedWatch.

key_facts.fact: Two-year Treasury yields have risen more than 50bp in September, their largest monthly rise since February 2023.
key_facts.excerpt: Two-year Treasury yields... have shot up more than 50 basis points so far in September, their largest monthly rise since February 2023, in anticipation of more Fed hikes.

key_facts.fact: Fed Governor Lisa Cook said Monday she expects continued inflationary pressure in coming months from AI-related demand and higher oil prices, without saying more hikes will be needed.
key_facts.excerpt: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook said on Monday she expects continued inflationary pressure in coming months stemming from AI-related demand and higher oil prices, though she stopped short of saying more interest rate hikes will be needed.

key_facts.fact: The Fed under Chair Kevin Warsh raised rates 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16, its first hike in three years; core PCE is due Sept 30 and September payrolls (consensus 84K) on Oct 2.
key_facts.excerpt: The Federal Reserve, now led by Chair Kevin Warsh, hiked its benchmark rate by 25 basis points on September 16... The fed funds rate sits at a range of 3.75% to 4.00%... September nonfarm payrolls land Friday, October 2... The consensus sits at 84,000 jobs added

stories.headline: US and Iran resume indirect talks via mediators as Gulf crude exports hit a war-time high

key_facts.fact: Trump said talks with Iran were held on Monday Sept 28 through mediators, after he rejected Tehran's proposal to reopen Hormuz in exchange for concessions.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump said that talks with Iran were held on Monday (Sep 28) through mediators. The US president earlier rejected a proposal by Teheran to reopen Hormuz if Washington made some concessions.

key_facts.fact: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran expects a US response on Tuesday to its latest proposal; Iran still ties reopening Hormuz to an end to hostilities, sanctions relief and lifting the US naval blockade.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran foreign minister, Abbas Araqchi, says that Tehran expects to receive a US response today to its latest proposal surrounding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz... Iran continues to tie the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to specific conditions.

key_facts.fact: Citing CNN and Axios, reports said Trump expressed willingness to offer Iran sanctions relief and release frozen funds, pulling crude down from its daily peak.
key_facts.excerpt: According to media reports from CNN and Axios citing White House officials, President Donald Trump expressed a willingness to offer Iran sanctions relief regarding nuclear issues, pulling crude prices down from their peak levels of the day.

key_facts.fact: Middle Eastern crude exports climbed to 12.8 million barrels per day in September, the highest since the war began in February, per Kpler data.
key_facts.excerpt: Crude exports from major Middle Eastern producers climbed to 12.8 million barrels per day in September, their highest level since February, preliminary Kpler data showed, helped by increased shipments from Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

key_facts.fact: Saudi Arabia restored about half the flows through its East-West pipeline, hit by drones earlier in September, to at least 3.5 million barrels a day.
key_facts.excerpt: Saudi Arabia has restored about half the flows through its cross-country East-West pipeline... Flows through the link to the Red Sea have reached at least 3.5 million barrels a day

key_facts.fact: Brent traded above $107 on Tuesday, up more than 70% this year; Brent's prompt spread widened to over $7 a barrel from under $1 at the end of August.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent traded above $107 a barrel... Brent is up more than 70% this year... Brent's prompt spread... has widened to more than $7 a barrel, from less than $1 at the end of last month.

stories.headline: Russian jet drones hit Kyiv's Academy of Sciences as Putin orders army expanded to 1.55M troops

key_facts.fact: A Russian drone hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv on Monday Sept 28, killing at least two; Zelensky said nine people were killed and more than 80 injured nationwide.
key_facts.excerpt: Emergency officials said the strike on the National Academy of Sciences on Monday killed two people... He said at least nine people had been killed in Russian drone strikes throughout the country, while more than 80 people were wounded.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said 90 of 120 drones fired on Monday were jet-powered, with an interception rate of 57% for that type.
key_facts.excerpt: 90 of 120 drones fired on Ukraine on Monday were jet-propelled, rather than propeller-driven, with an interception rate for this type of drone at 57 percent.

key_facts.fact: Overnight into Sept 29 Russia launched a Zircon/Onyx missile, two Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles and 152 attack drones (82 jet-powered); Ukraine shot down or suppressed 109 targets.
key_facts.excerpt: Russian forces launched a Zircon/Onyx anti-ship missile, two Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles, 152 Shahed-type attack drones – 82 of them jet-powered... Ukrainian air defenses had shot down or suppressed 109 aerial targets

key_facts.fact: A presidential decree issued Monday raises Russia's armed forces to 2,441,630 personnel, including 1.55 million active servicemen, an increase of 15,500 troops.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the decree, the overall strength of Russia's armed forces will rise to 2,441,630 personnel, including 1.55 million active servicemen – an increase of 15,500 troops.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said more than 8,000 North Korean troops are in Russia and another 10,000 are being prepared for deployment, with Russia helping set up Shahed-type drone production in North Korea.
key_facts.excerpt: There are currently more than 8,000 North Korean troops on Russian territory. In addition, preparations are underway to deploy another 10,000 troops... production of shahed-type attack drones has been established in North Korea with Russian technical support.

key_facts.fact: Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha accused Russia of 'deliberately expanding the boundaries of what it believes the world will tolerate' and asked allies for more air defence.
key_facts.excerpt: "Russia is deliberately expanding the boundaries of what it believes the world will tolerate. Every attack left without a strong response only encourages the next one," he said, calling on Ukraine's allies to provide it with more air defences.

stories.headline: NASA sets uncrewed Starliner flight for December and will certify ULA's Vulcan to carry crews

key_facts.fact: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said on Monday NASA is targeting no earlier than December 2026 for an uncrewed Starliner-1 mission to the ISS, with a crewed Starliner-2 planned for 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: "NASA is targeting no earlier than December 2026 for an uncrewed Starliner-1 mission to the International Space Station to validate the recent remediation efforts... and plan for a crewed Starliner-2 mission in 2028."

key_facts.fact: NASA astronaut Woody Hoburg was assigned to command the first crewed return flight, Starliner-2.
key_facts.excerpt: NASA astronaut Woody Hoburg has been assigned to command that first crewed return flight

key_facts.fact: Because only six Atlas V rockets remain, NASA will work with Boeing and ULA to certify the Vulcan Centaur for Starliner; spacecraft upgrades plus Vulcan certification are valued at $359 million.
key_facts.excerpt: NASA will begin working with Boeing and United Launch Alliance towards certifying the Vulcan Centaur rocket for Starliner... plus the Vulcan certification that is 359 million.

key_facts.fact: The uncrewed flight will test redesigned propulsion valves and other fixes ordered after the 2024 mission that stranded two astronauts on the station for more than nine months.
key_facts.excerpt: NASA is working with Boeing to launch an unpiloted Starliner capsule in the December-January time frame to test upgrades and improvements ordered in the wake of a 2024 mission that suffered multiple propulsion system failures, stranding two astronauts on the space station for more than nine months.

key_facts.fact: Vulcan is currently grounded over problems with Northrop Grumman-built solid rocket boosters and is expected to return to flight late 2026 or early 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Vulcan, which has its own troubles and is currently grounded while engineers from ULA, Northrop Grumman, NASA and others work through problems with NG's GRM-63XL solid rocket boosters. Vulcan is expected to return to flight late in 2026 or early 2027.

stories.headline: FDA approves Egetis' Emcitate, the first US treatment for rare MCT8 deficiency

key_facts.fact: On Sept 28 the FDA approved Egetis Therapeutics' Emcitate (tiratricol) for peripheral thyrotoxicosis in adults and children with MCT8 deficiency (Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome), the first FDA-approved treatment for the disease.
key_facts.excerpt: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved EMCITATE® (tiratricol), a thyroid hormone receptor agonist, for the treatment of peripheral thyrotoxicosis in adults and pediatric patients with monocarboxylate transporter 8 (MCT8) deficiency (Allan–Herndon–Dudley syndrome)... EMCITATE is the first FDA-approved treatment option

key_facts.fact: The FDA granted Egetis a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher, which the company may monetize as early as Q4 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: the FDA granted Egetis a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV). The Company currently expects to explore monetization of the PRV, which could potentially occur in the fourth quarter of 2026

key_facts.fact: The approved indication does not cover the disorder's neurological impairment; Egetis expects commercial availability 8-10 weeks after approval and gave no list price.
key_facts.excerpt: The approved indication does not include the disorder's neurological impairment... Commercial availability remains an eight-to-10-week forecast, while the Sept. 28 announcement gave neither a U.S. list price nor a sales projection.

key_facts.fact: Efficacy came from an international randomized placebo-controlled study and a longer open-label study showing reduced excess circulating thyroid hormone and improved systolic blood pressure and heart rate.
key_facts.excerpt: efficacy was evaluated in an international, randomized, placebo-controlled study and a longer-term open-label study. Across the two studies, patients treated with Emcitate had reductions in excess circulating thyroid hormone and improvements in systolic blood pressure and heart rate.

key_facts.fact: Separately on Sept 28, Teva announced FDA approval of Degevma (denosumab-adet), a biosimilar to Amgen's Xgeva, its second FDA-approved biosimilar of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Sept. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. ... today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved DEGEVMA™ (denosumab-adet) as a biosimilar to Xgeva® (denosumab)... DEGEVMA is Teva's second FDA-approved biosimilar in 2026

stories.headline: FBI memo says hackers may have stolen data on all its employees; ShinyHunters says it won't publish

key_facts.fact: In an internal memo reported Sept 28, the FBI said it believed ShinyHunters may have stolen sensitive information on all of its employees, potentially tens of thousands of current and former staff.
key_facts.excerpt: In an internal memo, the F.B.I. said it believed the hackers may have stolen sensitive information on all of its employees... reams of sensitive personal data involving potentially tens of thousands of former and current F.B.I. employees is emerging as one of the worst breaches of sensitive government information

key_facts.fact: The memo offered virtual briefings and told employees to remain vigilant at home and at work.
key_facts.excerpt: On Monday, the New York Times reported the FBI sent a memo to staff saying it would offer virtual briefings and instructed employees to remain vigilant while at home and their place of work.

key_facts.fact: On Monday ShinyHunters told 404 Media and Nextgov it never intended to publish the data, calling the one-week ultimatum a 'marketing campaign'; it did not say it had deleted the records.
key_facts.excerpt: "Since the very beginning we had made our decision that we would never publish this data..." ... "This was all a marketing campaign to protect our business and actively combat disinformation," ... its latest statement does not say it has deleted the records.

key_facts.fact: Exposed records identify employees working on intelligence matters involving Russia, China, Hezbollah and cartels, plus staff of the bureau's Remote Operations Unit.
key_facts.excerpt: the exposed information identifies employees working on intelligence matters involving Russia, China, Hezbollah and cartels, as well as personnel involved in human intelligence and electronic surveillance. The records also included employees in the bureau's Remote Operations Unit

key_facts.fact: The group claims it stole 2-3TB of data via an Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day on the FBIJobs.gov portal, moving into the FBI's AWS GovCloud environment.
key_facts.excerpt: The ShinyHunters extortion gang claims it breached FBI systems using a new Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day vulnerability... ShinyHunters claims it stole between 2TB and 3TB of data... These systems allegedly include the FBI's AWS GovCloud environment

key_facts.fact: The FBI told 404 Media it is 'working around the clock' on the FBIJobs.gov incident and has sent multiple bureau-wide communications.
key_facts.excerpt: "The FBI is working around the clock to investigate the cyber incident involving FBIJobs.gov and is in regular communication with anyone who may be impacted — including multiple Bureau wide communications within 24 hours of public reporting."

stories.headline: Senate Democrats' report says Tether's USDT is central to Iran's sanctions-evading shadow banking

key_facts.fact: A 28-page report released Monday Sept 28 by Sen. Richard Blumenthal, top Democrat on the Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, analyzed blockchain data from 846 sanctioned or blocked Iran-linked wallets.
key_facts.excerpt: a new Senate investigation led by Sen. Richard Blumenthal and released Monday. In the 28-page report... the panel's Democratic investigators analyzed blockchain transaction data from 846 crypto wallets that had been sanctioned or otherwise blocked because they were associated with Iran.

key_facts.fact: The report found 87% of 757 wallets implicated in Iranian terrorism financing predominantly transacted in USDT.
key_facts.excerpt: The report said Iran's financial networks rely heavily on USDT, citing that 87% of 757 wallets "implicated in Iranian terrorism financing had predominantly transacted in USDT."

key_facts.fact: Investigators said Tether repeatedly failed to freeze wallets with strong indicators of illicit finance; Blumenthal wrote to AG Todd Blanche and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urging probes of possible sanctions and banking-law violations.
key_facts.excerpt: The investigators also said Tether failed repeatedly to freeze and block wallets... In letters to Attorney General Todd Blanche and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Blumenthal also urged them to investigate potential sanctions and banking law violations.

key_facts.fact: The report highlighted Tether's ties to the Trump administration, including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's former firm Cantor Fitzgerald, a Tether custodian, and ex-White House crypto council head Bo Hines, now CEO of Tether U.S.
key_facts.excerpt: Before joining the administration, Lutnick led Cantor Fitzgerald, which acts as a custodian for Tether... Bo Hines, the previous executive director of the White House Crypto Council, now CEO of Tether U.S.

key_facts.fact: Tether responded Monday that it had helped freeze $550 million in Iran-linked USDT over the past year.
key_facts.excerpt: On Monday, Tether released a post, which said it had helped freeze $550 million in USDT linked to Iran over the past year.

sources.title: Tether's USDT at center of Iran's shadow banking network, new Senate Report says
